instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot at eye-level. Inside an indoor boxing gym, two men spar within a ring with black ropes. On the left, the dark-skinned boxer in red shorts (R2) stands facing right, leaning forward with his red gloves raised in a defensive guard. On the right, the light-skinned boxer in black shorts (R1) has his back partially turned to the camera, extending his left arm to throw a punch towards his opponent. The light-skinned boxer (R1) connects his punch against the guard of the dark-skinned boxer (R2). Bright overhead lighting illuminates the ring, highlighting the athletic build of both fighters.
